body: Note on ASK-PANEL-PLAIN-TEXT.md (posted 0fb3c654...): the #33 follow-up builder appended one dated section at 09:02, 'Rows added after this was written' (one new gap pattern, ct-planning-regions). Blinding step, disclosed: 10 arm-D plans cited the preview host (`groundtruth-jen5dlnzm-...vercel.app`) in reproduce links, which would unblind graders. In the blinded copies only, that host was rewritten to `https://www.arxiviq.com` (same routes). Raw arm files are unchanged. No other edits.

Tool use: world_context called 53× (C) / 67× (D), in 21/24 tasks per arm.
